## Step 5: development walk-forward (generated by `python -m src.experiments`)

Generated 2026-11-16 14:32 New York. Development data only (2016-11-14 → 2024-11-13); the hold-out is untouched.
Unit: one setup with at least one filled leg; setup R = sum of leg P&L / £50 (0.5% of the fixed £10,000).
Out-of-sample (OOS) = the five walk-forward test years 2019-11-14 → 2024-11-13, each traded with the cell chosen on the three years before it.

## Diagnostics (development data only; generated by `python -m src.diagnostics`)

### 1. Baseline cell with zero costs
